Vendored unmodified from the WebAssembly demo at
https://laurentmazare.github.io/pocket-tts/ (Pocket TTS by Kyutai, WASM build
by Laurent Mazare, using the xn library: https://github.com/LaurentMazare/xn).

  worker.js          the demo's Web Worker (loads weights from Hugging Face)
  ptts_wasm.js       wasm-bindgen glue
  ptts_wasm_bg.wasm  compiled model runtime

The license for these files was NOT verified when they were copied (GitHub was
not reachable from the build sandbox). Check the upstream repository license
before publishing this page.
